purpose: Test stronger compact reasoning over the same complete controlled-failure pool as round 1, without selecting known positives or replacing alerts after audit.
changes_from_round1: Enabled high reasoning and a 16384-token response budget.
96000-byte prompt limit to allow longer complete-test contexts.
128-call / 2.4-million-token search budget instead of 64 calls / 500000 tokens.
comparison_limit: This is a stronger compute baseline, not an equal-cost algorithm ablation. It uses ordinary compact source context, without the separate API documentation augmentation in the round-12 component.
native_runs: Reuse frozen prior controlled failures; rerun selected alerts if needed for final verification. Historical candidate programs include prior oracle revisions, so this is fresh semantic review of an existing pool, not cold-start generation.
report_policy: Stop at the first model-supported candidate per case. Audit every alert. Unknowns remain unknown; keep all 17 trials in denominator.

execution_hold.reason: A later auto-review rejection disputed authorization for the same existing external provider. The already-running worker was stopped with SIGSTOP pending explicit user confirmation.
